title: AUB’s 9-month profit growth slows on trading losses

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Asia United Bank (AUB) posted a record net income of P9.4 billion in the first nine months of 2026, nearly unchanged from a year earlier, as trading losses tempered growth in lending and fee-based earnings. The bank and its subsidiaries’ earnings edged up 0.3 percent, translating into a return on equity of 18 percent and a return on assets of 2.9 percent.
